cases.prompt: Our React Native app needs to read the device's thermal state from native code on iOS and Android. Set up the native module inside this existing app.

all.why: creates a local library inside the app

expectations: Scaffolds a local library inside the existing app (the `--local` flow) rather than a separate npm package.
Chooses the Turbo Module type with native languages for both platforms (such as kotlin-objc).
Mentions that the local library is picked up by autolinking, or suggests checking `--help` before relying on the flags.

cases.prompt: Scaffold a new npm package `react-native-haptics-kit` that wraps the native haptics APIs, with an example app to try it in.
expectations: Uses `npx create-react-native-library@latest react-native-haptics-kit` for a standalone library, not the --local flow.
Passes non-interactive options such as `--no-interactive`, `--type turbo-module` and `--example expo`.
Suggests running the tool with `--help` first to confirm the current options.
